app.title: Show HN: ADRs for AI – Deliberation records for human–AI work, versioned in Git
app.author: lumbroso
app.description: Command‑line tool for recording, versioning, and querying deliberation records between humans and AI.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `adrs init` to create a new project
Create a dummy deliberation record with `adrs record` and verify it is stored
Query the records with `adrs list` and measure output consistency
Run a benchmark of record insertion at 1000 records/sec
